Subject: ClearWave trial assessment — post-call recap & proposed plan

Hi Ana / ClearWave team,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — quick post-call recap and a concrete next-step plan so we can kick off the trial without surprises. TL;DR: Monica (AM) will own timing & communications, Rishi (Infra) will own staging provisioning, Ava (CS) will own onboarding and evaluation support.

Success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: p95 generation < 200ms for 2k token window on your 20 req/s baseline.
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions for 30 minutes without queueing.
- Quality: end-to-end relevance pass rate >= 88% on your benchmark set (we'll ingest your sample corpus).
- Observability: access to request/response logs + token-level latency + custom metric exporter (or temporary CSV export).

Proposed evaluation plan (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): ClearWave provides sample dataset + access requirements.
2) Day 1–2: Redwood provisions dedicated staging instance (isolated tenant).
3) Week 1: Smoke tests + basic integration (functionality + auth).
4) Weeks 2–3: Load + quality runs (we'll run the benchmark harness and share results).
5) Acceptance gate: meet latency & quality thresholds OR agreed exception path.

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm the sample dataset delivery ETA (schema + representative queries).
- Confirm whether staging must be VPC-only (we can support VPC with 48–72h lead time).
- Any compliance docs needed up front (SOC2/PCI/etc) — we can share SOC2 brief.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-eval-playbook.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)] — contains a checklist, acceptance gates, and runbook we will execute. Also link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/clearwave-eval-playbook

If that looks good, I'll schedule a provisioning window and Rishi can call out any technical constraints.

Thanks,
Monica

Thanks Monica — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can deliver a representative sample dataset by Wed, 1 Jun (CSV + query pairs). I'll attach the schema.
- Staging must be reachable from our VPC (private peering preferred). We can accept a temporary peering or SFTP drop depending on what you recommend.
- We need a short compliance checklist before provisioning (SOC2 evidence + data handling notes). Do you have a short pack?
- One ask from our platform team: token-level logging for only failed requests (privacy constraints). Is that configurable?

Regarding time: our initial expectation was a two-week run, but we're flexible if we have early visibility on metrics. Also, please confirm if there are any usage costs during the trial or if it is covered by the POC credit.

FYI — Ana confirmed sample data for 1 Jun and reiterated VPC requirement + limited token logging. Please see her notes below.

Action items for internal owners:
- Rishi: confirm whether we can support VPC peering within 48–72h and whether we can scope token-level logging for failed requests only. Also call out any infra changes needed for the dedicated staging instance.
- Ava: draft a short onboarding timeline and comms to ClearWave (include measurement cadence).

2) Custom exporter requirement — if we can't provide their exporter quickly, we should offer our sidecar template.
3) Long-tail latency/regression — propose a hotfix path & rollback plan if production metrics show degradation.

Please reply in-thread with ETA and planned mitigations; I'll capture into the evaluation playbook and share with Ana.

—Monica

On Mon, May 31, 2027 at 9:08 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> FYI — Ana confirmed sample data for 1 Jun and reiterated VPC requirement + limited token logging.

Thanks — technical notes and plan:

Provisioning ETA:
- We can stand up an isolated staging tenant in ~48 hours once we have the dataset and the VPC peering details (CIDR + route target). If ClearWave prefers SFTP, we can have a temporary ingest pipeline in ~24h.

Token-level logging:
- Configurable to capture token-level details only on failed/errored requests. We'll need a short retention window for that data (default 7 days). If they need longer retention we will need a written exception.

Exporter/observability blocker + mitigation:
- Risk: ClearWave requires a custom metrics exporter that isn't in our standard set.
- Mitigation: we will deploy our sidecar exporter template (exporter-template.tar.gz) and a small adapter (see attached staging-config.json) to map Redwood metrics to their format. That adapter is low-risk but will require one small config change at their ingest endpoint.

Hotfix & escalation path (if we hit a blocking bug during the run):
1) Triage in-thread and create SUP ticket (SUP-1234).
2) If severity >= Sev2 (production-impacting for the trial) escalate to Infra on-call: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai (30 min response target).
3) If fix is non-trivial, Rishi will trigger a canary rollback and coordinate a hotfix release; Monica will notify ClearWave and propose schedule.

Attachments: [Attachment: staging-config.json (text, 8KB)], [Attachment: exporter-template.tar.gz (archive, 95KB)]

I'll start work as soon as we have the peering details or confirmation to use SFTP.

—Rishi
Senior Engineer, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

Ana — thanks for the fast turnaround. Confirming next steps and owners below so we have a single source of truth in the playbook: 

Owners:
- Project lead / comms: Monica Patel (Redwood) — primary point for scheduling and status updates.
- Infrastructure & hotfix owner: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) — provisioning, metrics exporter, canary/rollback.
- Customer success & evaluation cadence: Ava Chen (Redwood) — measurement plan and weekly checkpoints.
- ClearWave data/ops owner: Ana Velasquez / ClearWave Platform team.

Timeline (target):
- 2027-06-01: ClearWave delivers sample dataset (confirmed).
- 2027-06-02 (by EOD): Redwood provisions staging tenant (or temporary SFTP ingest if peering delayed).
- 2027-06-03–09: Smoke + integration + run baseline benchmark.
- 2027-06-10–16: Load runs and quality evaluation.

Acceptance gates (what we will sign off on):
- Gate 1 (smoke): auth + basic request/response parity.
- Gate 2 (baseline): p95 latency under 200ms on sample set + basic relevance score >= 88%.
- Gate 3 (final): no Sev1/Sev2 infra incidents during the load window or documented mitigation & rollbacks.

Escalation path (quick reference):
- In-thread SUP ticket -> Infra on-call (sean.gallagher@redwood.ai) -> Engineering lead (rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai) -> Monica for commercial decisions.

I will upload the updated playbook (with owners, timeline, and the mitigation table) to the Drive link and share it after this thread. Attaching our hotfix process doc for transparency.

Attachments: [Attachment: hotfix-escalation.md (markdown, 6KB)]

Monica
